streaming.title: Event Studio
streaming.disabledBody: This section is paused until the video infrastructure is ready. Camera operation, local recording, simultaneous destinations, and live output cannot be used from Studio right now.
streaming.disabledDestinations: Simultaneous output to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and custom RTMP is disabled.
streaming.disabledCameras: Camera links and the multi-camera workflow are disabled until the next infrastructure phase.
streaming.disabledLocalCapture: Local capture and recording are disabled to avoid exposing an incomplete feature.
streaming.enabledBody: This event has Studio access. Public live output will connect when the operational infrastructure is configured.
streaming.lockedBody: Local Studio, event operation, matchmaking, bouts, printing, analytics, and dashboards are available to promoters and managers without charge.
streaming.localModeBody: You can prepare the fight card, review graphics, use the browser camera, and record on this device. This does not publish a signal online or upload files to the server.
streaming.noCameraPreview: Start the local camera to see preview here. The browser will ask for camera and microphone permission.
streaming.downloadHelp: After stopping a recording, download it before closing this page.
streaming.serverOutputBody: Real public output is deferred until SRS and FFmpeg servers are available. For now this screen prepares and demonstrates the Studio workflow.

destinations.title: Simultaneous destinations
destinations.body: Configure the destinations this event will use once the video server exists. In this phase the workflow is prepared; it does not stream yet.
destinations.securityBody: Do not paste real stream keys here during the demo. Use an internal reference. Real keys must be stored in secure backend secret storage when live output is activated.
destinations.name: Internal name

cameras.title: Event cameras
cameras.body: Each camera should have its own operator or access link. The producer controls which camera goes to preview and which camera is sent to output.
cameras.accountRuleBody: Do not use a shared account. Each operator should use their own account or a temporary event link once the video server exists.
